svg.title: Shadow Gate — Solo Leveling-inspired hotspot concept board
svg.desc: Visual concept board showing palette, desktop and mobile wireframes, system window components, button states and hunter rank badges.

g.text: 02 // DESKTOP LAYOUT — ASYMMETRIC GATE + SYSTEM WINDOW
THE SYSTEM HAS DETECTED YOUR PRESENCE.
STATIC GRADIENTS · NO LOOPS · NO BLUR
NO TILT · NO RIPPLE · INSTANT TRANSITIONS
RIPPLE · SLIDE-UP SHEETS · PAUSED WHEN HIDDEN
PARALLAX TILT · LAYERED GATE · RUNES · SPARKLES
• 100% LOCAL ASSETS — NO WEB FONTS, CDNs, OR REMOTE IMAGES. CAPTIVE PORTALS OFTEN HAVE NO INTERNET BEFORE LOGIN.
• ALL MIKROTIK VARIABLES, CHAP, TRIAL, STATUS, LOGOUT, ADVERT, REDIRECT AND WISPR XML FLOWS PRESERVED.
• ORIGINAL VECTOR ART AND SYNTHESIZED SFX — NO COPYRIGHTED CHARACTER ART OR OST AUDIO.
• JS-DISABLED LOGIN STILL POSTS. DIALOGS FALL BACK. REDUCED-MOTION AND FORCED-COLORS SUPPORTED.
• TARGET: FIRST MEANINGFUL PAINT < 500MS ON ROUTER LAN · < 1.5S ON THROTTLED 3G.

svg.text: SHADOW GATE // CONCEPT BOARD // BUILT ON THE ONE-PIECE-THEME PERFORMANCE ARCHITECTURE
